//: Every dependency the three implementations share, at one exact version: the latest on npm when it was last updated. A measured difference then comes from the styling and not from the dependencies (fairness rule 1). `bun scripts/sync-versions.ts` writes these into the Kirana corpus and both baselines, and `--check` fails when one drifts. The styling tools are not here: each workspace pins its own, Kirana through `scripts/use-kirana.ts`. `react-is` is here because `recharts` asks for it as a peer: without it, each workspace picks whichever copy happens to be hoisted. `differences` lists any dependency the three cannot share, with the reason; it is empty.
